description: This file is a C source file for the ssp_main module in the XHFW_Ssp component, handling initialization and termination of bus platform communication, including callbacks, subsystem setup, and system commands.

methods.name: msgBusInit
methods.description: Initializes the bus platform, sets component name, engages message bus, initializes subsystem, and starts Parodus task.

methods.name: msgBusTerm
methods.description: Terminates the bus platform, stops subsystem, and cancels message bus engagement.
